title: 'The judge saw the truth': San Antonio woman wins $32K judgment against HOA after three-year battle
comment: After a three-year fight, a San Antonio homeowner won more than $32,000 from her HOA — and $12,500 of that came personally from the board president for interfering with her rental contract. Both have since paid.
excerpt: 'The judge saw the truth': San Antonio woman wins $32K judgment against HOA after three-year battle KSAT

title: SC man who is banned from all Walmart locations charged with felony larceny in Stanly County
comment: He holds a permanent lifetime ban from every Walmart in the country, which is why $1,900 in electronics also came with a trespassing charge. Police put his running total across stores somewhere north of $100,000.
excerpt: SC man who is banned from all Walmart locations charged with felony larceny in Stanly County Queen City News

title: Georgia Man Turns Traffic Stop Into Bizarre Pursuit Ending in ‘Slowest PIT,’ Police Say
comment: A driver declined to stop for the traffic stop, then declined to speed up, producing what the department is billing as possibly the slowest PIT maneuver in its history. The original offense was ignoring a traffic-control device.
excerpt: Georgia Man Turns Traffic Stop Into Bizarre Pursuit Ending in ‘Slowest PIT,’ Police Say Yahoo

title: Look: Trapped coyote rescued from between walls in Pittsburgh alley
comment: A coyote wedged itself into the gap between two buildings in a Pittsburgh alley and could not reverse out. Crews had to open up the wall to get it loose.
excerpt: Authorities in Pittsburgh handled an "unusual situation" involving a coyote that wandered into an alleyway and wound up wedged between two walls.

title: Look: Overdue magazine returned to N.H. library after 132 years
comment: A magazine borrowed from a New Hampshire library came back 132 years late. Nobody appears eager to calculate the fine.
excerpt: A New Hampshire library said a patron will not have to pay a $12,055 fine for returning a magazine checked out 132 years earlier.

title: Watch: Five generations of Iowa family share a single birthday
comment: Five consecutive generations of one Iowa family were all born on the same calendar day. The odds are long enough that the cake arrangements are now permanent.
excerpt: An Iowa family is being recognized by Guinness World Records for an unusual distinction: five generations sharing the same birthday.

title: Edmond City Council closes 72-year-old loophole in parking ordinance
comment: Edmond's parking ordinance carried the same loophole for 72 years before the council got around to closing it. Somewhere a very patient resident is taking this personally.
excerpt: Edmond City Council closes 72-year-old loophole in parking ordinance The Oklahoman

title: Seven Pennsylvania DAs Now Pursuing Vivid Seats Hidden-Fee Lawsuit
comment: Seven Pennsylvania district attorneys are now jointly pursuing Vivid Seats over fees that only surface at the end of checkout. The price on the listing was, allegedly, never the price.
excerpt: Seven Pennsylvania DAs Now Pursuing Vivid Seats Hidden-Fee Lawsuit TicketNews
